findings.text: The new receipt-identity guard sits under scripts/prototypes/, which pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] testpaths (line 289: ["tests", "nova/imas/..."]) does not collect, so no repository gate runs it; a regression in the seven receipt fields would redden nothing in the default lane, and the identity comparison added in test_profile.py:46 does not close the gap because it is in the same uncollected tree.

The test records the root-hop counts (counts[name] = depth) but asserts only depth["visits"] at line 68; nothing asserts the bounded root-hop depth that is the node's actual goal, so reinstating the unbounded, uncompressed sweep (the pre-repair _neighbour_roots pointer-doubling) reddens no test — the receipt is unchanged by that regression and the depth is measured and written to JSON but never compared.

The gate log's first line names REVISION=cd169244542ed6f8bacbcde8bb7bb4db864c4409, but the file it ran (test_brute_receipt_identity.py) does not exist at that revision; it was added in 0f80a85c7, so the log cannot be reconciled against the commit it cites.

the manifest's tests: field names a script path (.../gpu-recheck.sh) rather than the literal command a shell was handed, so a reader cannot re-run the gate from that line alone and must fall back to each log's own COMMAND= header.
